blocks.content: Two modal families. Modals.tsx holds NewProjectModal (folder browse/up/Choose…/new-folder creation, optional project name — M4 scaffolds AGENTS.md/.xtracsys.md into new projects) and PermissionCard (the approval dialog with Deny/Allow/Always allow, where Always allow captures the command pattern or write scope). WelcomeWizard.tsx is the P8 first-run flow: backend probe with model counts, folder pick, and a create-project finish that writes provider/model settings and boots the first chat.
Browse + create folder inline; scaffolds config files on create when scaffoldOnCreate is on.
three-way approval including the Always-allow rule capture (N2).
Skippable 2-step wizard shown only when no projects exist.
